title: A terrible experience… so far
text:
I downloaded this app earlier today after it was highly recommended through a third party. I went through the setup process, and it seemed to have a very nice and polished UI. I added a couple plants and explored the app a bit, but I noticed that on a few occasions, there was a bit of a lag — including one instance where the activity indicator was spinning for about 20 seconds or so.

Despite this, I decided to go ahead and subscribe, since, again, it appeared to be a nice app overall. Additionally, I put trust in the reviews, which are primarily very positive. 

When I clicked to authorize the subscription to the app, I got the activity indicator again. It spun for about minute before giving me a popup that said:

“An error occurred
The operation couldn’t be completed.
(PremiumManager.PremiumError error 1.)”

I closed out the app, reopened it, and got… you guessed it… the activity indicator before I could even get into the app. At that point, I deleted the app, redownloaded it, and opened it back up. This time it appeared to open correctly, and I noticed that it was allowing me to access the app as a guest or non-subscriber. That’s what I expected, due to the error message that I got when I tried to subscribe.

However, just to be sure, I went into my active subscriptions to verify that I hadn’t been subscribed. Well, despite the error message, it clearly showed that the subscription DID go through. So, I went back to the app and selected “Restore purchase.” Do you want to guess what happened next? That’s right! I got the activity indicator again (this time for two minutes), until the app gave me the following message:

“No Subscription Found
We couldn’t find an active
Subscription for your account.”

Ugh…

This isn’t an issue on my end. I’m using an iPhone 16 Pro Max with over 400 GB of free space, updated to the current iOS (26.0.1), and an internet connection that averages barely under 1 Gbps. Additionally, I downloaded, and subscribed to, the app with my VPN off, and I also tried the aforementioned steps through both my home internet connection and cellular data. Finally, I did multiple hard resets on my phone at various times. 

I’m going to leave it alone for a few hours before I try again, but let’s just say that I’m very disappointed and unimpressed with Planta so far. It’s definitely more disappointing that anything else.

Unfortunately, however, after following this apps advice to the letter, my body count has risen to three separate tropical house plants in the matter of months (living in a tropical climate mind you). I experimented in stopping following planta’s advice and purchasing the exact house plants that I killed and they are thriving now. I’m not claiming to be an expert or knowing better than planta at all. But I am claiming that advice from the app caused me to overwater and kill 2 plants ($60 in value). text: Non si capisce come segnalare un problema su una pianta già inserita nel profilo. Oltretutto non riconosce le piante… 🤨

title: Interessante ma inaffidabile nelle identificazioni
text:
Anche se un po’ macchinosa da usare, l’app è comoda per censire tutte le piante che si hanno. 
Attenzione all’identificazione! Funziona molto male: per esempio, la alocasia cuprea l’ha identificata come Monstersa Monkey mask. La caparra orbifolia l’ha scambiata per un singonyum e l’alcosia black bel et per una peperomia. Non ci siamo!

title: Ma per le piante piantate a terra?
text:
App interessante, ma sembra non abbia il giardino tra gli ambienti. Mi chiede sempre il tipo di vaso…
Tra l’altro non potendo fare una prova gratuita di un paio di giorni sei costretto a buttare via 8 euro prima di accorgerti se ha le funzionalità che ti servono. 
Va bene solo per chi abita in appartamento….

title: Buono
text: Potrebbero esserci tips e troppo articoli ancora non sono tradotti.

title: Not localized
text:
The tips and info are not localized in Spanish or Italian as promised in the App description but only in English. That’s not fair -.- 
I made a 3 month subscription but I do not fully get the suggestions…
